albums.title: FaultLine E1M1 stencil shadows FPS on-off
albums.description: RTX 4090, deployed workspace FaultLine engine, 3840x2160, uncapped, vsync and GPU profiler off, no sound. Same-session alternating stencil on/off, three roughly 3-second wall-clock bench intervals per state. SPOM, SSR (64 steps, quarter resolution) and baked mover lighting enabled throughout. Entry camera: player 480 -352 88, angles 0 90 0. Initial wall probe camera: 1614 -971 -682, angles 26 270 0; close-up wall view is less representative. Screenshots were captured outside measurement windows; their FPS overlay is transient, not the benchmark result. Project and deployed configs remain stencil-off; tests used isolated configs.
albums.result: Passed: 12 FPS intervals across two cameras. Entry room median: stencil ON 185.0 FPS / 5.4043 ms (184.5-185.9 FPS); OFF 233.0 FPS / 4.2917 ms (231.0-235.3 FPS): +25.95% FPS, 1.1126 ms saved. Initial close-up wall probe: ON 194.1 FPS / 5.1510 ms; OFF 262.7 FPS / 3.8067 ms: +35.34% FPS. Both runs completed successfully; no renderer changes.

albums.title: Stationary ramp jitter / standard player
albums.description: FaultLine E1M1: reproduced zero-input jitter at (858, -694, -373), compared engine 0.183.159 with 0.183.160, and stabilized physical ramp support. The graph shows matched stationary camera and gravity traces; screenshots show the final standard player on both movement backends.
albums.result: Baseline: stationary jitter reproduced on both backends, including the reported position (camera spans 0.246 and 0.392 units). Two intermediate candidates failed the stationary seam gate; contact-detail diagnostics completed. Final fix: all ten idle windows pass, body span and velocity zero, no support switching or camera clipping, maximum remaining eye settling 0.001942 units. Exact deployed release repeat: both reported-position windows have zero body/camera/basis movement and five clearance checks pass. Movement regression: 5,353 checks pass across six gravity directions on both backends. Initial forced-240-Hz regression was stopped as too slow and recorded incomplete; 72-Hz rerun passed. Release builds, Python compilation, whitespace checks and three deployment hashes pass. An obsolete build-target attempt failed, then the normal target built successfully; a temporary plotting-module filename conflict was corrected. Fix committed and pushed as 2d4cecab. Deployed version 0.183.160 SHA256 7b9799a61bdcd5107953efdb1224b4e4c1d87d1f76bd405778e43baf123a62e0. Project map and QC unchanged.
albums.label: Idle gravity 0.183.160

albums.title: FaultLine / E1M1 · Skull relief and stencil shadows
albums.result: Fixed and deployed: legacy brush depth bias no longer pushes shell relief inside its own stencil shadow. Release build succeeded; engine SHA-256 6b9a3da267e343f1be526d1ccfb91dfab5a22382dd5ad19347bf04a437a595ec matches all three deployment targets. At 3840x2160, full-depth, scale 0.2, and hard-stencil skull cases exactly match their stencil-off and z-fix-off controls within the door crop (six comparisons, maximum difference 0); POM still changes 67,392 pixels versus flat. Mover fixture passed at rest, displaced, and returned: 14,552 / 24,147 / 14,552 shadow pixels; returned mask and world-only difference 0. Earlier POM floor camera still passes at 4K: 0 backstop changes or exposed backstop pixels across 5,088,027 pixels; 421,627 relief changes. First staged 4K launch lacked adjacent runtime DLLs and produced no images; checker reported missing inputs. DLLs were supplied, then capture and checks passed. Previous diagnosis failures remain in this album history. Default reversed-Z tested; compatibility depth path not retested. Shader cache retained locally to avoid repeating the cold compile. No map rebake needed. Source committed and pushed as 101f3e29.
albums.label: Fixed depth

results.text: Reproduced the reported skull-panel patches behind spawn at 1080p. Backstop, baked self-shadow, and SSR isolation did not remove them; disabling stencil shadows did. Cold startup was interrupted and retried with a shader cache; the initial close camera went through the door and was corrected. An experimental flat-receiver approach did not fix the patches; its initial GLSL reserved-name error was corrected. That broader experiment was removed. Final physical-depth fix remains under test.

Current exported map passed a private fixed-4u/two-bounce bake: all 109 rest/pose entries, 75 playback poses, valid 16,800,013-byte atlas.
